candidates.change_summary: Move the line that sets rewardsForA[recipient] = 0 to after the external call, so balance is zeroed only after the call returns.
Remove the line that zeroes the stored reward before the external call, so stored reward remains unchanged after withdrawReward.
Change the transferred amount to amountToWithdraw + 1, altering the amount sent and leaving stored value unchanged until after call (would revert if insufficient contract balance).
Remove resetting of the lock after function execution (_locked = false), leaving the contract permanently locked after the first guarded call.
Move the line that sets claimedBonus[recipient] = true to before the call to withdrawReward, so the bonus is marked claimed prior to withdrawal.
Remove the line that sets claimedBonus[recipient] = true so the claim flag is never set after first withdrawal.
Change the reward amount added from 100 to 0 so no bonus is credited before withdrawal.
Insert an additional increment to rewardsForA[recipient] after withdrawal so state retains added reward despite withdrawal zeroing it earlier if withdraw failed to send.
Set claimedBonus[recipient] = true only when rewardsForA[recipient] is zero after withdrawal, making claimed status depend on successful balance zeroing.
